_meta.title: Be The Tree Hugger / CommuniTREE Admin — Reverse-Engineered Spec
_meta.method: Authenticated headless-browser inspection (DOM + network) + GraphQL introspection. SuperAdmin account.

stackObserved.frontend: React SPA bundled with Vite (asset hashes like bth-33a1bc68.png), Material-UI (MUI) component library, NotoSans font, Google Maps JS API (forest geo picker), client-side routing (react-router; routes /, /dashboard).
stackObserved.dataLayer: Axios over XHR. Two API surfaces on the same host dev-api.bethetreehugger.co: (1) custom REST under /api/v1/* for list/search reads, (2) PostGraphile GraphQL at /graphql for entity CRUD + relation reads. Auth service separate host dev-auth.bethetreehugger.co.
stackObserved.backendInferred: Node.js. PostGraphile auto-generates the GraphQL API directly from a PostgreSQL schema (evidence: *Connection/nodes/byXId naming, nodeId, __typename). DB migrations managed by Sequelize (SequelizeMeta table present). REST layer is a separate Express service wrapping the same DB for paginated list/search.
stackObserved.database: PostgreSQL. 52 tables recovered from introspection. snake_case columns; PostGraphile exposes them camelCase, REST returns raw snake_case.

authObserved.tokenStorage: localStorage: token, role, profileId, userDetailsData (JSON), forestUniqueId, ForestID.
authObserved.restAuth: Authorization: <token>   (RAW token, NO 'Bearer ' prefix — Bearer prefix yields 500 'jwt malformed'; wrong/absent header yields 403 'Missing Authorisation Token!')

colors.primaryUseage: Add buttons, Next/Save buttons, active tab underline, stepper progress, logo wordmark/leaf

spacing.scale: MUI 8px base (theme.spacing). Card padding ~24px, field gap ~16-24px, page gutter ~24px

components.name: AppHeader
components.behavior: White top bar. Left: leaf logo + 'Be The Tree Hugger' wordmark (green). Right: user avatar with dropdown caret -> menu with 'Log out' (clears localStorage, returns to /).

components.name: TabNav
components.behavior: Dark gray secondary bar of MUI Tabs. Active tab = white text + green underline. Switching tab swaps the section's DataTable in place (URL stays /dashboard). Each tab triggers that entity's REST list call on first activation; results are cached client-side (React Query) so re-selecting does not refetch.

components.name: DataTable
components.behavior: Card containing: SearchBar (left), AddButton + FilterButton (right), MUI table with per-entity columns, footer with RowsPerPage select (default 10) + numbered pagination. Each row has action control(s) (edit/view/delete). Server-side pagination via {page,limit} in the list POST body.

components.name: SearchBar
components.behavior: Debounced text input ('Search users...', 'Search forests...', etc). Sends search term to the list endpoint (server-side filter, inferred).

components.name: FilterButton
components.behavior: Funnel icon button; opens a filter popover (per-column filters; e.g. reports/list returns filter_limit). Exact filter fields not fully enumerated — OPEN QUESTION.

components.name: AddButton
components.behavior: Green primary button. Opens the entity create dialog/wizard.

components.name: Pagination
components.behavior: Prev / numbered pages / Next. Page count derived from pagination.total in response.

components.name: EntityFormDialog
components.behavior: MUI Dialog with outlined fields. Footer: Cancel (close, no save), Reset (clear fields), Save (validate -> POST create or PATCH update via GraphQL mutation -> toast -> refetch list -> close).

components.name: FormField
components.behavior: MUI outlined TextField with floating label. Required fields marked with '*'. Inline helper/error text below on validation failure.

components.name: RoleSelect
components.behavior: Combobox populated from /api/v1/roles/list (SuperAdmin, Admin, ...). Used in Add/Edit User.

components.name: Stepper
components.behavior: CORRECTED (live walk-through): the wizard is TWO steps only — '1 Basic Info' and '2 Grid Config' (the '1-6' seen earlier were the forest LIST pagination behind the modal). Numbered horizontal stepper with green progress bar; completed step shows a check. Footer step1: Cancel / Reset / Next->. Footer step2: <- Previous / Cancel / Reset / Save Forest.

components.name: EditBoxDialog
components.behavior: Sub-modal opened by clicking a box card in Grid Config step. Header 'Row R • Column C' + Capacity/Planted/Remaining counters (capacity = treeRows*treeColumns, e.g. 25 for 5x5). Fields: Prefix (text), Start Digits (number, default 1), Start (number, auto-calculated). 'Enter prefix to add species details.' -> species rows appear. Cancel / Done. Generates ForestBox + tree unique IDs (prefix+running number) for that box.

components.name: MapLocationPicker
components.behavior: Google Maps embed with 'Search location' autocomplete; 'Click to update coordinates' sets forest_geo_lat/long. Recenter control. Part of Add Forest step 1.

components.name: SpeciesSearchSelect
components.behavior: Async search backed by POST /api/v1/master-plantspecies/search (large catalog ~67KB). Used in forest wizard for species selection.

components.name: AvatarCell
components.behavior: Round avatar or 2-letter initials in user/sponsor/employee tables.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.behavior: Inferred for destructive row actions (delete -> GraphQL delete mutation). Not visually confirmed — OPEN QUESTION.

components.name: Toast
components.behavior: Snackbar feedback after mutations (inferred standard MUI snackbar).

screens.name: Forests
dataCollected: CORRECTED via live walk-through. TWO-step wizard. Step1 'Basic Info': Forest Name*, Forest Internal ID*, City*, State*, Country*, Address, Description, map coordinates (Google Places search 'Pick Location on Map*'), Site Manager*(employee autocomplete), Sponsor*(autocomplete), User*(autocomplete). Step2 'Grid Config': Box Rows*, Box Column*, Box to Box Distance(ft)*, Tree Rows*, Tree Column*, Tree to Tree Distance(ft)*, Direction Angle*, Boundary Gap(ft)*, Pathway Spacing(ft)*, Project Site*, Project Period(years)*, Plantation Date* -> renders a grid of Box cards (rows x cols); each card opens EditBoxDialog (prefix/startDigits/start -> tree IDs + species). Final action 'Save Forest'. Submit goes through forest/upsert which runs the async forest_upsert_v1 job that materializes boxes/trees/clusters.

flows.name: Login
conditions: existing valid token in localStorage -> auto land on /dashboard

flows.name: Create simple entity (User/Sponsor/Employee)
conditions: missing required -> inline errors, no submit

flows.name: Create Forest (2-step wizard) [CORRECTED via live walk-through]
steps: Step1 Basic Info: name, internal id, city/state/country, address, description, map pick coords, assign Site Manager + Sponsor + User (all required except address/description)
Next -> Step2 Grid Config: box/tree grid dims + spacing + project site/period + plantation date (all required) -> generates Box cards grid
optionally click each Box card -> EditBoxDialog (prefix/startDigits -> tree unique IDs + species)

Save Forest -> POST /api/v1/forest/upsert (multipart) which enqueues forest_upsert_v1 async job that creates the forest + ForestBox + ForestTree + ForestCluster rows (+ join rows ForestSponsor/ForestsEmployee)
flows.outcome: Forest + boxes/trees/relations created via async job (status visible in Jobs tab)

steps: row action (edit -> prefilled dialog -> update<Entity>ById; delete -> confirm -> delete<Entity>ById)

steps: non-super Admin scoped via UserRoleForestAccess rows
conditions: role from localStorage.role gates UI + API filtering (inferred)
